name: Sudatel Data Center Khartoum (SDC)
notes: Official Sudatel DC page (Sinkat Street, Khartoum) describes the facility as Sudan's largest data center, 14,000 m2, four equipped rooms with nearly 1,000 servers each, Tier IV-standard claim; services colocation, dedicated/virtual servers, SAN, DR, cloud. Sudan Tax Authority projects page confirms a signed colocation contract with Sudatel for the main tax authority data center. Capacity 3 MW is aggregator-derived (DC Hub/datacentermap), not official. Tier claims are operator-stated, not independently certified. War context: Khartoum facilities were disrupted 2023-2025; current operational status re-checked 2026-08-12.

name: Sudan State (National) Data Centre, Khartoum
notes: Actum Sudan, quoting Minister of Digital Transformation Ahmed Dardiri via SUNA, reports reactivation of Sudan's main 1,300 m2 state data centre in Khartoum after technical/infrastructure rehabilitation, equipped with cloud computing, data protection and AI-support systems, intended to host government systems centrally (announced 9 Oct 2025). Primary SUNA page not retrievable in this run, so grade B; whether the 1,300 m2 facility is physically the NIC/NDC site remains unresolved (methodology de-dup note). Khartoum power/drone damage context makes ongoing operation date-sensitive.

name: Canar / Canartel Khartoum data center (Al-Mashtal Street)
notes: Aggregators list an operational Canar Telecom Sudan data center at Al-Mashtal Street, Khartoum (11,840 sq ft raised floor, 250 kVA) and a Canartel DC at Canar Tower. Legacy fixed-line operator facility (Canar merged into Sudani); may be distinct from Sudatel SDC at Sinkat Street or a duplicate legacy listing - aggregator-only evidence, no official facility page verified in this run.

name: SudREN Khartoum Sector Data Centers Project
notes: SudREN official projects page (verified live 2026-08-12) lists a Sectoral Data Centers Project with a Khartoum Sector covering Khartoum State (10 public universities, 21 private, 78 colleges, institutes, research centers, teaching hospitals); page states the program is in launch phase. Programme-level planned evidence, no site/MW disclosed; not a built facility yet.

name: Soba Hospital Data Center
notes: SudREN official page lists Soba Hospital Data Center (national scope, Soba is in Khartoum State) as a specialized center for connecting and securing data for all teaching hospitals across Sudan; 'in launch phase' per the same page. Planned programme record, no capacity disclosed.

name: Sudatel DC Port Sudan (SAS1) / Port Sudan core data center
notes: Sudatel's group statement says it operates two Tier III data centers and holds EASSy/SAS1/SAS2 stakes; aggregators identify the second facility as Sudatel DC SAS1 Port Sudan (Dim Al-Nour Street area, Tier III). CGTN (2026-01-07) reports Sudani restored the core data center in Port Sudan and it is fully operational serving government, private institutions and citizens after Khartoum damage; Freedom House 2024 notes a new Port Sudan data center from Feb 2024. Cable landings (EASSy/SAS1/SAS2) at Port Sudan corroborate the hub role (TechCentral). Capacity 3 MW is aggregator-derived (DC Hub); exact street/capacity remains C-level detail per methodology.
